name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer focused on the Diablillos project in Argentina's Salta and Catamarca provinces. The flagship project received approval under Argentina's RIGI investment regime in 2026, with a construction decision expected in the second half of 2026. The company is in the development stage with an updated mineral resource estimate filed in 2026.
